headline: GO084 adds a source-level systemd holding action for volatile semantic state; real-host preflight proves lifecycle wiring is still absent and no live mutation occurred
state: self-integration main now contains the accepted fail-closed volatile-state guard, its 10-case self-test, a systemd drop-in source, and log/2026-09-12-084-fluechtiger-semantischer-zustand-startschutz.md. The drop-in places the guard in ExecCondition so it executes before the base unit's destructive ExecStartPre and resets the base unit's unconditional ExecStopPost wipe. Real-host preflight on andreas-maco shows entityos-vm.service active/running, no existing ExecCondition, no DropInPaths, and both intended installed target paths missing. Therefore source protection is ready but live lifecycle protection remains zero. An attempted live-install dispatch was blocked by the execution safety layer before dispatch; that boundary was not bypassed and the host service was not modified, stopped, or restarted.
next: Under admitted real-host effect authority, install the exact accepted guard and drop-in without restarting the VM, daemon-reload, prove MainPID and ActiveEnterTimestamp unchanged, prove ExecCondition loaded and destructive ExecStopPost removed, then rerun the installed guard expecting rc=255 while the four volatile semantic stores remain. Only after that protection is live should an explicit hash/readback-bound migration/export move those stores into an admitted durable layer.
